title: Inventory: Perlstein et al. 2007 (Nat Genet 39:496) supplementary information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/perlstein2007/raw/`: every 'Supplementary information' item linked from
https://www.nature.com/articles/ng1991 (fetched with plain requests and a cookie jar, 2026-11-02), untouched. The article page is
saved as `sources/perlstein2007/article.html`; it carries the abstract and the supplement captions, the main text and Methods are
paywalled. The paper is not in PubMed Central. PDF tables are flattened line for line into `extracted/` by `extracted/extract_tables.py`.

roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM236_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 1: complete list of SMPs (92 numbered names; FDA-approved drugs highlighted in green, colour not extractable).
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM237_ESM.xls: Supplementary Table 2: raw data, normalized final yields of each segregant in each SMP (phenotypes; kept in raw/ only, not drawn).
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM238_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 3: complete list of SMP/linkages (219 compound × dose × time-point rows: marker, chromosome, position, LOD).
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM239_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 4: collapsed list of SMP/linkages (123 rows).
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM240_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 5: collapsed list of confidence intervals (124 rows: base-pair peak, LOD, CI start/end/length). Drawn.
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM241_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 6: complete list of QTL hotspots (8 columns: chromosome, base-pair position, number of SMPs, SMP names).
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM242_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 7: primer sequences for the L259P and D55N PHO84 allele-swap strains.
roles.41588_2007_BFng1991_MOESM243_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Note: literature-supported candidate genes at the chrI (SWH1) and chrXIV (MKS1) hotspots, stated as unverified.

missing: Main text and Online Methods (paywalled): the linkage statistic, LOD threshold, FDR and confidence-interval definition are not in the bundle.
No effect sizes or directions for any linkage.
Which two polychlorinated phenols PHO84 was verified for is not named in the accessible text (read as dichlorophene and pentachlorophenol, the only polychlorinated phenols in Table 1).
Table 1 lists 92 SMPs; the abstract says 100.
